facts.value: For each passed exam, you will receive a digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), which is recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University.
This certificate will be issued in bilingual format (German and English).
You can use this language certificate for your application abroad or later in your job search.
You can only find out your grades once you receive your certificate via email, approximately 4 to 5 weeks after the exam date.
Grades for elective module courses and Master’s Course: You can view your grades password-protected in QIS.
